title: Remove Launch sample execution detail flat aliases
summary: Removed three Launch sample-execution display-helper compatibility aliases from the flat window surface while preserving the mediaPipelineLaunchView namespace contract.
reason: Continue opportunistic WebView flat-export cleanup in the touched Launch real-media domain without changing backend mutation, media policy, command routing, source media handling, or pending-publish behavior.
behavior_before: Launch sample-execution status/summary/detail helper functions were available both through window.mediaPipelineLaunchView and direct flat window.launchSampleExecution* aliases.
behavior_after: Launch sample-execution status/summary/detail helper functions remain available through window.mediaPipelineLaunchView only; direct flat window.launchSampleExecutionStatus, window.launchSampleExecutionSummaryLines, and window.launchSampleExecutionDetailLines aliases are no longer exported. launchSampleExecutionRows remains flat because the browser readiness smoke still intentionally uses it.
tests_added: Extended existing Local API WebView static assertions to require Launch sample-execution status/summary/detail namespace exports and reject the removed flat aliases.
rollback_plan: Restore the three Launch sample-execution status/summary/detail flat window assignments in launchView.js, revert the namespace/no-flat test assertions and docs/generated artifacts, refresh summaries, and rerun the targeted WebView validation ladder.
